board: Seeed Studio Grove - Water Atomization v1.0 (SKU 101020090)
reason: Digital actuator (EN high = mist) modelled from the Seeed v1.0 schematic (EN -> 1k -> 9013 -> NCE3407A high-side switch, ETA1617 boost, NE555 105 kHz driver); VCC 5 V up to 2 W fed from a separate supply. Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (3 runs; one failure came from leaving out the mpn).
